verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation is an OS that users download and run on their own hardware. The release manifest lists downloadable images, including WSL and container variants. The vendor says it is free and that 'your data belongs to you.' Community users report running Fedora on their own machines and home servers, and building custom setups from Fedora Minimal. Missing for 10: explicit first-party installation/self-deployment documentation, explicit statement of open-source licensing or source availability.
